name: Mitsugi
source:
An architectural designer. He’s a cool lone wolf type, just as he appears, but, fundamentally, his exterior is that of a sensible, common-sense man. However, it takes surprisingly little to make his anger boil over. He’s been hostile towards Azuma alone from their very first meeting for some reason. Azuma isn’t without blame either, calling Mitsugi a “blonde shithead” to his face; Whenever these two are in the same spot together, expect a fight to break out. Seems to be participating in the tour for some reason related to his work. Good with his hands.

[Source: [URL=http://pilslash.jp/product/paradise/chara/?chara=2]official website profile[/URL].]
